items.title_en: Thomas Markle, Meghan’s father, jailed after cutting off ankle monitor, DoJ says
items.title_zh: 梅根父親湯瑪斯·馬克爾因剪斷電子腳鐐入獄，司法部表示
items.summary_en: Thomas Markle was arrested for keeping illegal files. He cut off his electronic ankle monitor. Now he is in jail waiting for a court hearing.
items.summary_zh: 湯瑪斯·馬克爾因持有非法檔案被捕。他剪斷了電子腳鐐。目前他被關押在監獄中，等待法院聽證會。
items.why_important_en: This news involves a high-profile family member and legal issues regarding electronic monitoring.
items.why_important_zh: 這則新聞涉及知名人士的家庭成員以及關於電子監控的法律問題。

vocab.definition_en: To take someone to the police station because they did something wrong.
vocab.sentence_en: The police had to arrest the man for stealing a car.
vocab.sentence_zh: 警察必須因該男子偷車而將他逮捕。

vocab.definition_en: The state of being kept in prison by the police.
vocab.sentence_en: The suspect will remain in custody until the trial begins.
vocab.sentence_zh: 嫌疑人在審判開始前將會繼續被拘留。

items.title_en: House votes to effectively end the impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth
items.title_zh: 眾議院投票實質終止對皮特·赫格塞斯的彈劾行動
items.summary_en: House Republicans stopped a vote to impeach the Defense Secretary. The effort to remove him from his job has ended.
items.summary_zh: 眾議院共和黨人阻止了對國防部長的彈劾投票。將他免職的行動已經結束。
items.why_important_en: It shows how political parties use voting power to stop official investigations.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了政黨如何利用投票權來阻止官方調查。

vocab.definition_en: Physical or mental activity needed to achieve something.
vocab.sentence_en: We made a great effort to finish the project on time.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們為了準時完成專案付出了巨大的努力。

vocab.definition_en: To take something or someone away from a place.
vocab.sentence_en: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
vocab.sentence_zh: 進入屋內前請脫掉您的鞋子。

items.title_en: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
items.title_zh: 以色列新國會宣誓就職，領導人競爭組建政府
items.summary_en: Israel has a new parliament. Different political leaders are trying to become the next prime minister.
items.summary_zh: 以色列有了新的國會。不同的政治領袖正在爭取成為下一任總理。
items.why_important_en: Government formation is critical for national stability and policy direction.
items.why_important_zh: 政府的組建對於國家穩定與政策方向至關重要。

vocab.definition_en: To try to win something that others are also trying to win.
vocab.sentence_en: Many companies compete to sell the best smartphones.
vocab.sentence_zh: 許多公司為了銷售最好的智慧型手機而競爭。

vocab.definition_en: To start or create an organization or group.
vocab.sentence_en: The students decided to form a new study group.
vocab.sentence_zh: 學生們決定組成一個新的讀書會。

items.title_en: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
items.title_zh: 美國連續第二年抵制聯合國人權審查
items.summary_en: The U.S. did not attend a U.N. human rights meeting again. Experts worry this makes it harder to hold countries responsible for their actions.
items.summary_zh: 美國再次沒有參加聯合國人權會議。專家擔心這會讓追究各國責任變得更困難。
items.why_important_en: The U.S. absence from international human rights discussions may affect global standards.
items.why_important_zh: 美國缺席國際人權討論可能會影響全球標準。

vocab.definition_en: A formal assessment or examination of something.
vocab.sentence_en: The manager will conduct a performance review next week.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理下週將會進行績效評估。

vocab.definition_en: The fact of not being where you are expected to be.
vocab.sentence_en: Please explain your absence from the meeting yesterday.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請解釋你昨天為何缺席會議。

items.title_en: Twelve dead after motorway pile-ups in Bulgaria fog
items.title_zh: 保加利亞大霧導致高速公路連環車禍，造成十二人死亡
items.summary_en: A bad accident happened on a highway in Bulgaria because of thick fog. Twelve people died and many others are hurt.
items.summary_zh: 保加利亞的一條高速公路上因濃霧發生了嚴重事故。十二人死亡，許多人受傷。
items.why_important_en: This highlights the dangers of driving in poor weather conditions.
items.why_important_zh: 這凸顯了在惡劣天氣條件下駕駛的危險性。

vocab.definition_en: An unfortunate event that happens unexpectedly and causes damage or injury.
vocab.sentence_en: I had a small accident while driving to work today.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我今天開車去上班時發生了一點小事故。

vocab.sentence_en: The athlete is injured and cannot play in the game.
vocab.sentence_zh: 那位運動員受傷了，無法參加比賽。
